value.hook: Open when delegating a security review or receiving a verdict-only review response.
value.title: Require evidence in delegated review reports

sections.name: body
sections.value: A delegated "no vulnerabilities found" sentence is not enough to support publication. Require the exact head, repo-relative file:line receipts for each requested check, actual probes performed, and explicit proof limits in the returned report. On #239 the first response omitted those receipts; one same-task follow-up recovered the reviewer's retained evidence without a second review or duplicated parent source reads. Keep CI/finality verification and publication with the role holder, and distinguish author-supplied mutation/live receipts from independently observed results. Product-specific lessons are already in the two cache-proxy notes; do not duplicate them at closure.
